reuseNotes: Reproduced without modifying, adding to, or deleting translation content.
Publisher, source, version, and transcript information must remain identified.
Refresh against the latest QuranEnc version before future bulk updates.

arabic.note: Canonical Arabic is kept separate from the Bengali translation.

pronunciation.provider: Bangladesh Ministry of Religious Affairs Quran Digital
pronunciation.note: The first seven Al-Fatihah pronunciations are bundled in Bengali script and reviewed against the Arabic verses and the Ministry's Bengali transliteration presentation. Remaining verses stay explicitly unfilled until independently reviewed; no automatic Latin-to-Bengali conversion is used.
